name: null-format
description: In-box code formatting with Prettier, rustfmt, and clang-format for Null IDE

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test out/diffUtils.test.js out/configResolver.test.js out/toolchainDiscovery.test.js out/prettier.test.js

null-format.prettier.enable.description: Enable Prettier formatting for JS, TS, JSON, CSS, HTML, YAML, and Markdown.

null-format.prettier.configPath.description: Optional path to a Prettier config file. If empty and no project config is found, 'null-format.prettier.defaultConfig' is used.

null-format.prettier.defaultConfig.description: Default Prettier configuration applied when no workspace config file (.prettierrc, package.json) or custom configPath is found.

null-format.clangFormat.enable.description: Enable clang-format for C, C++, and CUDA.

null-format.clangFormat.path.description: Optional path to the clang-format executable. If empty, clang-format is auto-detected from bundled binaries, LLVM, Visual Studio, or PATH.

null-format.clangFormat.configPath.description: Optional path to a .clang-format file. If empty and no workspace .clang-format is found, 'null-format.clangFormat.defaultConfig' is used.

null-format.clangFormat.defaultConfig.default:
BasedOnStyle: LLVM
IndentWidth: 4
TabWidth: 4
UseTab: Never
ColumnLimit: 100
AccessModifierOffset: -4
AllowShortFunctionsOnASingleLine: Inline
BreakBeforeBraces: Attach
Standard: Latest
null-format.clangFormat.defaultConfig.description: Default clang-format configuration (in YAML or style string format) applied when no workspace .clang-format is found.

null-format.rustfmt.path.description: Optional path to the rustfmt executable. If empty, rustfmt is auto-detected from bundled binaries, Cargo (~/.cargo/bin), or PATH.

null-format.rustfmt.configPath.description: Optional path to a rustfmt.toml file. If empty and no workspace rustfmt.toml is found, 'null-format.rustfmt.defaultConfig' is used.

null-format.rustfmt.defaultConfig.description: Default rustfmt configuration (in TOML format) applied when no workspace rustfmt.toml is found.
